annotation.speech2: A polar grid with concentric gray circles. The cardioid r equals one minus sine theta is drawn in blue: a heart shaped curve pointing downward, widest at the bottom where theta equals three pi over two and r equals two, with a cusp at the origin at the top where theta equals pi over two. The curve is symmetric about the y axis.
The cardioid r equals one minus sine theta, symmetric about the y axis.
